title: HR Industry Risks
label: 12-Industry Risks
markdown:
# HR Industry Risks

| Risk | Business impact | Control direction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI hiring bias or opaque scoring | Unfair exclusion, disputes and regulatory exposure. | Human review, explainable factors, bias testing, appeal records and conservative automation. |
| Sensitive-data leakage | Identity, salary, bank, performance or biometric exposure can cause serious harm. | Least privilege, encryption, tenant isolation, export control, retention and audit logs. |
| Over-monitoring | Excessive face or location collection may violate necessity and employee trust. | Purpose limitation, minimisation, alternative attendance methods and clear notices. |
| Payroll-rule error | Incorrect wages, tax or social-insurance treatment creates financial and labour disputes. | Region/effective-date rule versioning, reconciliation and approval before payroll closing. |
| Mature HCM competition | AI features are copied by global and regional suites. | Defend with industry templates, attendance-payroll closure, local rules and implementation speed. |
| Overseas localisation gaps | A China-centric workflow may fail on privacy, payroll, language or employment rules abroad. | Country configuration, regional partners, data residency and local legal review. |
